title: Moq Framework
description: Create and configure mocks with the Moq library.

data.text: **Moq** is the most popular mocking library for .NET. It allows you to create mock objects, set up behavior, and verify interactions.

data.title: Using Moq
Key Takeaways
points: Mock<T> creates a mock of type T
data.takeaway: Moq makes it easy to create and configure test doubles.
